video_title: The Ultimate Assist | Summer Of Jayson

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the lasting impact of his Duke basketball experience
quotes.excerpt: I didn't know that when I chose to go to Duke that it would have this big of impact on my life.
quotes.quote: I didn't know that when I chose to go to Duke that it would have this big of impact on my life. My relationship with Scheyer and the rest of the staff, even the trainers and Sam at B, the chefs, there's a lot of people that are still there when I was there. It's like going back home. There's people that saw me come in as an 18-year-old kid, they've seen my journey up until now, and they just always welcome me back with open arms.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the importance of returning to Duke to mentor younger players
quotes.excerpt: It's our responsibility to pay it forward. It means a lot to this program and we care about you guys.
quotes.quote: It was great to be back with the team. It was big for Kyrie to be back. I know Kyrie hasn't been back in a minute and I know everybody was happy to see him. It's a unique place where all these guys come back and pour into the program and just hang out for a weekend, play pickup with the guys. It's our responsibility to pay it forward. It means a lot to this program and we care about you guys. As much as y'all enjoyed this, I know we did too, and we just want to see y'all be the best y'all can be.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on mentoring Duke guard Caleb Foster during summer workouts
quotes.excerpt: I'm here to give him tools or the knowledge or experiences or whatever.
quotes.quote: A lot of those guys would text me throughout the season, but I would hear from Caleb probably the most. In July he hit me and was like, 'Let me know your schedule in August, I want to come work out with you.' We worked out for two days and it was just dope because two guys at different points in their life. Obviously, I know the way he looks up to me and respects what I've accomplished, and I'm here to give him tools or the knowledge or experiences or whatever. Wherever this path takes him, I just want him to succeed and all the guys at Duke.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the brotherhood culture within the Duke basketball program
quotes.excerpt: This whole brotherhood thing that we speak about is about being there for one another.
quotes.quote: This whole brotherhood thing that we speak about is about being there for one another, regardless of how old we are, where we're from. We all came through this program and somebody was there for me, right? Jabari Parker, Quinn Cook, Jahlil Okafor, Jahlil Okafor, Tyus Jones, Rodney Hood, all these guys that looked out for me when I was at Duke, when I left Duke. For me, it's always about paying it forward.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on his desire to be a role model for St. Louis youth
quotes.excerpt: I want to be that guy from St. Louis that made it, like really made it.
quotes.quote: I want to be that guy from St. Louis that made it, like really made it. Like Nelly really made it. He put St. Louis on the map, and now just trying to be that next guy of the superstar and that never forgot where he came from and always trying to push St. Louis forward.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the importance of intensity and competition at his elite camp
quotes.excerpt: Nobody is too cool to compete. We only here for a couple days and we're here to get better.
quotes.quote: First of all, I would just want to say I appreciate you guys taking the time to be here. I've been fortunate enough, this is my fourth year doing this camp. Some of you guys I do know from years prior and some guys I haven't met and I would like to know. I want everybody to get something out of this. For me, most importantly, leave that cool shit at the door. Nobody is too cool to compete. We only here for a couple days and we're here to get better and have a good time.

quotes.speaker: Chris Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul on the importance of hard cuts in basketball team dynamics
quotes.excerpt: You've got to cut hard because you might not get the ball, but it'll open up another guy's shot.
quotes.quote: You've got to cut hard, right? You've got to cut hard because you might not get the ball, but it'll open up another guy's shot.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the lasting impact of attending Chris Paul's elite camp
quotes.excerpt: I vividly remember going to KD's elite camp in DC when I was 15 years old.
quotes.quote: I vividly remember going to KD's elite camp in DC when I was 15 years old, going to LeBron James Skills Academy in Vegas. I remember being one of those kids. Seeing my favorite players come back and hear them talk about the game of basketball. I kind of just remember the impact that that had on me at that time.

quotes.speaker: Chris Paul
quotes.summary_phrase: Chris Paul on the tactical importance of setting screens at the right angle
quotes.excerpt: You got to be committed to setting the screen at the right angle every single time.
quotes.quote: If the king come off the right way, he got to go over the top. Now we got an advantage. I could cross-brain, then you see all these different lines. But you got to be committed to setting the screen at the right angle every single time. And Jayson Tatum, I know when he come set the screen, yeah, he going to hold, he going to grab and do all that, right? Because he want the switch. Even though I didn't mind having to guard him.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the significance of hosting an elite camp with Chris Paul
quotes.excerpt: To now, us doing an elite camp together, to share that with him is super cool.
quotes.quote: To now, us doing an elite camp together, to share that with him is super cool.

quotes.speaker: Jayson Tatum
quotes.summary_phrase: Jayson Tatum on the future of the next generation of NBA players
quotes.excerpt: I think that's like the coolest part is seeing them at this age and then knowing two, three years.
quotes.quote: I think that's like the coolest part is seeing them at this age and then knowing two, three years down the line, they're going to be in the NBA. I think that's like the coolest part is seeing them at this age and then knowing two, three years down the line, they're going to be in the NBA.
